state:
**Side goal `narrow-a-readonly-property`: stages 2 and 3 are closed, and stage 4 is open.**
A null test, `is`, a literal comparison and `match (true)` now narrow a path of `readonly` properties (`$this->a`, `$x->a->b`) as well as a binding. The path is keyed `x->a->b` in `LocalScope`'s one narrowing map (`crates/nvs-types/src/locals.rs`, `readonly_path`, `subject`, `narrowed_property`, `written_path_key`), so restore and loop suspend need no extra code. `LocalScope::drop_narrowing` drops every path rooted at the name, and `assign::note_write` drops the path a property write goes through. The module doc's narrowing section explains it.
The read records `ExprInfo::Property { narrowed: Some(to) }`. `nvs-ir`'s `checked_narrowed_read` (`crates/nvs-ir/src/lower/expr.rs`) tests the slot for `null` through `emit_null_guard`, the never-written guard's throw, so the error is a `LogicError` naming the property. Then it untags.
`rule:types/narrowing`'s subject paragraph already states the path, the root-write widening and the checked read, and lists the new cases in `guardedBy`. What stage 4 still owes the rules is one sentence somewhere that `readonly` is written once, with both halves: E0782 at compile time and `write_erased_property`'s throw at run time.
In this worktree the `extension` step of `bun nv verify` fails because `@types/node` is not installed, and `nvs-cli`'s `live_config` test fails under load and passes alone. Neither belongs to this goal.

items.text: **E0459 on a tested mutable property says a test does not narrow it**: when the nullable receiver is a `PropertyAccess` of a mutable property, the help says a test does not narrow a property that can change, and shows the local copy (`var $n = $x->p; if ($n != null) …`) and `?->`. Case `tests/conformance/reject/a-null-test-does-not-narrow-a-mutable-property.nvst`. `rule:types/narrowing` — `crates/nvs-types/src/expr/members.rs:1173`, `crates/nvs-types/src/expr/members.rs:1198`

**State "`readonly` is written once" as a rule**, with the compile-time half (E0782, E0843) and the run-time half (`write_erased_property`'s `RuntimeError`), in `rule:classes/lateinit-restrictions` or a new `classes/` rule, and render. `rule:classes/lateinit-restrictions` — `crates/nvs-types/src/locals.rs:547`
**The `the-feature-proofs` check**: `bun nv proofs --id` for the nullable-objects feature, and close whatever it names. `rule:types/narrowing` — `crates/nvs-types/src/locals.rs:606`

backlog: An `inout` argument that passes a `readonly` path is not known to drop its narrowing. The `nvs-ir` null check makes it safe, but the checker could drop the path there too (`crates/nvs-types/src/locals.rs` module doc, narrowing section).
LSP hover on a narrowed property read still shows the declared type, because it reads `ExprInfo::Property`'s `ty` and not `narrowed` (`crates/nvs-lsp/src/hover.rs`).
